data.one_liner: Fetch live currency exchange rates and convert amounts between currencies.
data.what_it_does: The package contacts a Skysol server to obtain current exchange rates. It provides a simple function to convert an amount from one currency to another using those live rates.
use_when: You need up‑to‑date currency conversion in a Flutter app
You want a minimal, cross‑platform solution without extra boilerplate
avoid_when: You require offline or cached rates
You need extensive currency metadata or historical data
You need a highly configurable HTTP client
strengths: Very simple API – one async call does the conversion
Works on all major Flutter platforms (iOS, Android, Web, desktop)
No code generation or additional setup required
weaknesses: Relies on a single external server – no fallback or caching
Only provides conversion, not full currency data

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: General purpose HTTP client with more control and no external service dependency

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Feature‑rich HTTP client with interceptors, retries and better error handling
